zh-CN.title: 投稿头像显示修复
items: 我的投稿现在只展示审批者头像，审批列表只展示投稿者头像
只有一位对应成员时使用清晰的大圆形头像，不再混入自己的头像
多人投稿或审批继续使用斜向头像组合与剩余人数提示

en.title: Correct submission avatars
items: My submissions now show reviewer avatars only, while the review list shows author avatars only
A single counterpart now appears as one clear circular avatar without including your own avatar
Collaborative submissions continue to use diagonal avatar stacks with an overflow count
